statement: Priority remove safety uses the existing authoritative voter-ready row sets to enforce per-REPLACE quorum and distinct-node spread non-regression instead of final-target satisfaction: serialized intermediate replacements may preserve two-node spread while the published target is three, but spread regression and voter-floor loss remain blocked; the unchanged interlock and membership/leadership safeguards hold, and the production five-node MovieLens milestone completes successfully.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Use the existing authoritative current/projected voter-ready row sets and published numeric target in the centralized remove-safety projection; do not add a parallel readiness Boolean, query, cache, or policy owner.

Preserve the operation-ledger self-move interlock, per-partition serialization, voter-count floor, membership proof, replacement readiness, leader-handoff safety, and retry ownership; only distinguish non-regression from final convergence.

Model serialized incremental replacements explicitly: the fixed policy must preserve quorum and monotonic spread while reaching the final target; the final-target-per-step policy must exhibit the 2-of-3 deadlock.
Do not change the MovieLens 180000ms schema budget, 60000ms stability window, workload, joins, preload size, ratings-only split policy, report conversion, or live scenario semantics.
